info.title: BitoCard API
info.description: One API for catalogue, quotes, orders, wallets and webhooks. Sandbox and live share this address; your API key decides the mode.

logo_url.description: HTTPS URL of the logo, or null to remove it.
HTTPS URL of the logo, or null to remove it.

email.description: Email address; a 6-digit code is sent to confirm it.

password.description: At least 10 characters. Passwords found in public data breaches are refused.

business_name.description: Business name shown on the reseller account. Defaults to your name.

country.description: Country the business operates in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). During the pilot: NG, GH or KE. Not needed with an invitation.

invitation_token.description: Join a reseller's team from an invitation link, instead of creating a reseller account.

identifier.description: Email address, or a verified mobile number in international format.

code.description: The 6-digit code that was sent to you.

phone.description: Mobile number in international format, or local format for your business country.

name.description: A name to recognise the key by, such as the system that uses it.

mode.description: test keys use the sandbox; live keys move real money.

scopes.description: What the key may do. Defaults to every scope.

overlap_hours.description: Hours the old key keeps working, so you can deploy the new one (0 to 72).

role.description: admin manages the team and keys; developer manages keys; finance and support have their own areas.

token.description: The token from the invitation link.

amount.description: Minor units of the wallet currency (for example 500000 = NGN 5,000.00).

return_url.description: HTTPS page the payer returns to after paying.

bvn.description: Nigeria: the BVN the bank needs to open the account. Passed to the bank, never stored by BitoCard.

bank_code.description: Bank code from the bank list.

amount.description: Minor units; at least the country minimum withdrawal.

plan.description: Plan code from the plan list.

phone.description: Airtime and data: the mobile number to top up.

account_number.description: Pay-TV and bills: the smartcard, IUC or meter number.

transaction_type.description: Pay-TV: change to this package, or renew it as the current package.

face_value.description: Face value in minor units of the product face currency: one of its fixed values, or within its range.

quantity.description: More than 1 for gift cards only.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer or sale. BitoCard never needs your customers to have accounts.

product_id.description: Set for one product; leave out for the whole category.

markup_bps.description: Markup over wholesale price in basis points (1500 = 15%). At most the Markup Protection Scheme cap.

url.description: An HTTPS address on the public internet.

events.description: Event types to receive; `*` for all, including types added later.

status.description: Enable an endpoint again after fixing it, or pause it.

expire_previous_in_hours.description: Hours the old secret keeps signing alongside the new one; 0 stops it now.

quote_id.description: An open quote. Each quote can be used for one order.

simulate.description: Test mode only: the outcome to simulate (default completed).

status.description: `processing` until the supplier confirms; then `completed` or `failed`. A completed order can later be `refunded`.

face_value.description: Face value of one item, in minor units of `face_currency`.

face_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the face value.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts below (your wallet currency).

wholesale.description: Your wholesale cost, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

tax.description: Tax BitoCard collects as seller of record, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

charged.description: Taken from your wallet: wholesale plus tax, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

price.description: Price your customer pays, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

reseller_profit.description: Your profit, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

recipient.description: Who received it: `phone` for airtime and data, `account_number` (smartcard or meter) for pay-TV and bills.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer, as given on the quote.

failure_reason.description: Why the order failed, for failed orders.

updated_at.description: When the order last changed. Use it to ignore an older event that arrives after a newer one.

completed_at.description: When the order completed or failed.

source.description: `checkout` (payment page) or `bank_transfer` (into your reserved bank account).

amount.description: Amount added to your wallet, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

post.description:
Fires once when the supplier confirms delivery: straight away for most orders, or after a later status check if the order was `processing` when you placed it. The wholesale cost and tax have been taken from your wallet.

Does not fire for orders that fail, and never carries gift card codes, PINs or electricity tokens: call `GET /v1/orders/{id}` to fetch them.

Comes after you place the order (`POST /v1/orders`). Can be followed by `order.refunded`.

parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with your endpoint secret>`. During a secret rotation there are two `v1` values; accept either. Reject timestamps more than 300 seconds from now.

parameters.description: Which attempt this is for this endpoint, starting at 1.

post.description:
Fires once when an order fails for good: every eligible supplier refused it, or the supplier confirmed it failed. The amount held from your wallet has been returned.

Does not fire while an order is still `processing` (an unclear supplier answer is checked again, not treated as failure).

Comes after you place the order. Nothing follows it.
